body:
Adds a Core2 source specimen and a regression through the real public `mori check` JSON/human paths and `stage::load`. It covers duty reads in conditions, an await guard and ordered statement roots, with signature/body input ordering and full Program equality. Production code is unchanged.

Validation: the selected Rust test passed; both CLI processes exited 0 and complete streams matched the pre-execution frozen expectations. The complete 15-node Program matched; 916 source pins bind the tested working tree to commit `258ea139a2ce39df82976822be27fc8a057a88ae`. One narrowly named guideline exception documents the fixture convention.

Expectations were hand-derived with implementation-source exposure. This is finite static admission/serialization coverage, with no action execution, independent financial outcome, native proof or ledger claim. Existing duty-read coverage in library roundtrips is retained. All 27 constructor obligations remain open; fresh full-candidate source/result review is pending.

Stacked on the Boolean coverage branch to preserve its pinned parent. Local evidence: `duty-read-source-check-20261018` and `concurrency-increase-main238/grammar-next1f3c`.
title: Cover public Core2 duty-read source checking
